dedupe_keys.name: usi del mare in sea pianificazione dello spazio marittimo unita di pianificazione

description: Usi del mare (In_Sea) - Pianificazione dello Spazio Marittimo - Unità di pianificazione is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mit.gov.it. The Emilia-Romagna Region contributes to the planning of the ‘Adriatic Sea’ maritime area, with particular reference to the sub-areas in front of the regional coasts (A3 and part of A7). Under the maritime spatial plans, each maritime area subject to planning has been subdivided into sub-areas, and subsequently into planning units (UPs), i.e. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Uses of the Sea (In_Sea) - Maritime Space Planning - Planning Unit" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2025-08-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
